paragraphs.title: Platform content license

paragraphs.title: Rulebook canon
paragraphs.body: Official game and compendium rulebooks (V1–V16) override forum speculation when conflicts arise.

paragraphs.title: Citation
paragraphs.body: When quoting rulebooks or Wikipedia summaries, include version, page, or URL.

paragraphs.title: Privacy
paragraphs.body: Do not share private user data, wallet keys, or ticket contents in public threads.
